fields.label: Consolidation Group
fields.description: The disposing group: the Consolidation Group root whose Consolidation Policy and declared accounts this disposal is measured under.

fields.label: Disposal Date
fields.description: The date control was lost. It must fall inside a declared fiscal period; that period's closing rate translates the proceeds, and the entity's Ownership Period ends on this date.

fields.label: Share Disposed %
fields.description: Must equal the group's current holding in the entity on the disposal date: only a full disposal is supported.

fields.label: Retained Interest %
fields.description: Must be 0. Partial disposals that keep an interest are not supported yet; dispose of the full holding or record the change as an ownership step.

fields.label: Proceeds Currency
fields.description: Pre-filled from the group's reporting currency; proceeds lines may still be in other currencies.

fields.label: Ownership Period
fields.description: Closed on approval: the entity's Ownership Period covering the disposal date ends on it.

fields.label: Proceeds
fields.description: What was received for the holding, by component. At least one line; a line of 0 records a disposal with no proceeds.

fields.label: Proceeds
fields.description: Computed when the disposal is saved, in the group's reporting currency. The gain or loss on disposal is measured by the consolidation journal from the entity's balances at the disposal date.

fields.label: Total Proceeds
fields.description: Sum of the proceeds lines translated at the disposal period's closing rate; posted to the Disposal Proceeds Account.

fields.label: Reopen Data
fields.description: What the Ownership Period held before this approval closed it; cancelling the approval restores exactly these values.

fields.label: Previous End Date
fields.description: The Ownership Period's End Date before the approval closed it on the disposal date.

fields.label: Previous Is Disposal
fields.description: The Ownership Period's Is Disposal flag before the approval.

fields.label: Previous Disposal Date
fields.description: The Ownership Period's Disposal Date before the approval.

fields.label: Previous Disposal Price
fields.description: The Ownership Period's Disposal Price before the approval.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set by the workflow: Approved is the submitted document, Cancelled the cancelled one.
